description: Block-pinned DeFi control-plane commitments, Base EAS attestations and governance proposals for agents.

environment.description: Local spec JSON (anchoring overrides, local index fallback)
environment.name: PACTA_SPEC_PATH

environment.description: Enables paid x402 tools against this gateway URL; the live gateway is https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev (unset: free tools only)
environment.name: PACTA_X402_URL

environment.description: Per-call USDC cap in atomic units (default 1000000 = $1.00; hard ceiling 5000000)
environment.name: PACTA_X402_MAX_ATOMIC

environment.description: Timeout per outbound request in ms (default 8000)
environment.name: PACTA_X402_TIMEOUT_MS

name: io.github.Fractal-Neurons/pacta
status: publication_pending: @pacta/mcp-server is not yet published to npm or the MCP registry. Use the remote MCP server now (no install): https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/mcp. The stdio server runs from a clone of the repository: node packages/mcp-server/bin/pacta-mcp.mjs.
title: Pacta

tools.description: Filter indexed records (protocol, classification, sprint, limit)
tools.name: pacta_list_commitments

tools.description: Base EAS anchoring: PactaCommitmentRegistry, schema, sprint attestation UIDs
tools.name: pacta_get_anchoring

tools.description: Governance proposals feed (forum, topic_id, chain, limit, include_repro)
tools.name: pacta_list_proposals

tools.description: x402 gateway status and discovery manifest (only when PACTA_X402_URL is set)
tools.name: pacta_x402_discover

tools.description: Pre-execution check of a contract: verdict, 0-100 risk score, proxy / admin / timelock, capabilities (chain, address, block)
tools.name: pacta_check_preflight

tools.description: Live control-plane scan of a contract (chain, address)
tools.name: pacta_scan_control_plane

tools.description: Live state of tracked queued timelock operations
tools.name: pacta_live_timelocks

tools.description: Re-run a tracked governance proposal's pinned reads live, pinned-vs-live diffs (forum, topicId)
tools.name: pacta_scan_proposal_diff

transports.install: from a clone of the repository (npm publication pending)
